name: ux-ui-design
description: Adaptive, interview-first UI/UX design. A concierge skill that aligns on goals, audience, usage, and visual direction through plain-language conversation, then produces whatever fits — mockups, journeys, token systems, component and motion showcases — capturing screenshots of its work as the committed visual record. Loosely integrates with agile-workflow.

interface.longDescription: One concierge skill (ux-ui) for design-phase UI/UX work. It interviews first — goals, audience, usage, and how the product should feel — in plain language (no named-style menus), then adapts the artifact shape to the project: comprehensive mockups, piece-by-piece option sets, additive extensions, or flow-shaped journeys. It offers screenshot capture of existing UIs (any product, not just HTML) to target or extract visual systems, standardization showcases for tokens/typography/components/motion, and style research and mashups. Mockups are throwaway single-file HTML in .mockups/; the agent captures screenshots of its own mockups and commits them as the durable visual record. Loosely integrated with agile-workflow item ids.
defaultPrompt: Use ux-ui-design to align on UI/UX direction through conversation before production code.
